args.title: Tamarack Components Newsletter Summary - Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter ("Freight pricing this quarter"): Covers freight pricing trends for the quarter, linking to a detailed article and flagging a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Linked article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges are now tied to weekly diesel price movements rather than a fixed schedule.
- Companion piece (subscriber content): Analysis found that shippers who split their volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
